scope: Separate instrumented 2 ms diagnostic; all42 quiet cells remain unchanged
interpretation: PostgreSQL COMMIT execution is measured separately from anchor upsert and type-registry execution. Header commit span includes final flush and commit. Category medians do not add to whole-request medians. Counter intervals include warmup; checkpoint completed-time counters can include work begun before the interval. Checkpoint overlap alone does not establish a cause. Protocol tracing and duration logging affect these diagnostic latencies.
